results.name: The invoice has a "Mark as paid" button; it opens a pop-up with three date wheels, kinds, inks and one button, and none of the old captions
The mouse wheel, the arrow keys, Page Up/Down and Home/End turn a wheel one row (or five) at a time, and the date line follows
Dragging a wheel turns it and it comes to rest on a row; tapping a neighbouring row brings it to the middle
Kinds and inks: each kind has its words and ink; an ink can be chosen on its own; the arrow keys move between kinds
Escape closes the picker without stamping; the invoice is untouched
Pressing the button does not close the pop-up: the controls fade, the card stays and becomes the stamp, and the scene plays
There is no ink until the stamp touches; after it lifts the impression is there and the toast comes up
Undo plays the scene backwards to the picker (the stamp is taken off the invoice, the picker is as it was)
Stamping again, then Done: the stamp leaves upward, the paper lies flat with the impression on it, and Download PDF / Next invoice come up
Download PDF opens the print layout with the stamp on it (kind, date and ink)
Closing leaves the invoice stamped: the impression is on the sheet, the heading says Paid, and the unsaved state shows
Saved with the invoice: after Save draft and a reload the stamp is still on the invoice, and it is in the stored document
Changing the stamp opens the picker on the stamp it has; Undo goes back to the earlier stamp, and Next invoice starts a clean invoice
At moments of the scene: card → solid stamp as the camera tilts → hover → drop → press → lift (the clock is held still for each)
The stamp is a real solid and the paper is the invoice itself: stacked 3D slices, no cached bitmap layers, and the sheet is the invoice preview markup
Each moment of the scene is saved as a frame (docs/research/invoice-stamp/qa/frames) for the storyboard
Keyboard: Enter stamps, Escape during the scene skips to the hovering stamp, Escape again is Done, Tab never leaves the pop-up
Reduced motion: no flight at all — the finished paper with its impression appears at once, with Undo, Download PDF and Next invoice
Dark mode: the card, the controls and the table follow the theme; the paper stays paper
Phone: the picker fits, the controls are finger-sized, a tap stamps, and the whole scene stays on the screen with no sideways scroll
WebKit: the picker opens, the scene plays to the hovering stamp, Done settles it, and the invoice carries the stamp
No script errors in any of it
